Nice family restaurant with good eats
Jun 2019 • Couples
Family run restaurant on the 2nd storey. Was not crowded when we visited. There were only 2 other local families dining. The menu has English description. We ordered a Hue fried rice which was fried with lots of ‘wok-hey’, a dish of very fresh clams cooked with lemon grass and chilli, a crab noodle and fresh spring rolls. The sauce for the spring rolls was not quite the same as the usual sauce and was good. Overall a satisfying meal!

A delightful discovery off bustling Ben Thanh Market
Feb 2019 • Family
Our tour guide during our recent port of call at Phu My for HCMC took us to this fantastic find. It looks unassuming on the outside--you have to walk past numerous nail salons/vendors before you take the tricky steps up to the rustic nicely-decorated dining room. The food--the rice cakes, beef pho, stuffed escargots, fried spring rolls, among a few others from the extensive menu--was delicious and full of flavor. Service was quick and efficient, and the place was clean. If you're looking for a restaurant that serves excellent regional Vietnamese cuisine, good value for money, frequented by locals, and away from the hoards of tourists, then this is a place to check out.

Quiet restaurant with good food and nice people
Jan 2018 • Couples
Walk down to the end of the pedicure/manicure alleyway and go upstairs. We were there at 2pm and it was pretty quiet but the food came quickly and it was very fresh and enjoyable. The waiter showed us how to eat the tasty dishes and we would have liked to have been in a larger party so we could taste more food. Substantial, delicious meals for 50-60,000 dong. Friendly place - glad we went for one of our last meals in Vietnam.

Hidden gem
Dec 2017 • Family
Stumbled upon this hidden gem. Don’t take what it looks like on the outside...before you take the deceiving steps (watch your head on the way up) up to a rustic looking dining room. We decided on this restaurant as apposed to all the other ones just steps away because we were feeling adventurous and it had a most of the items I was craving. The food was good, service was quick and place was clean for HCM standards. Left satisfied and ready to tackle the Bên Thành market just steps away.
